For size, the best figure is about 1,300 m² of technical area. The ERA Elektrotechnik supplier page states that

content.text: through the new build, space for another 10,000 servers was created on just under 1,300 m² of technical area.

A Salzburg24 news report gives the same roughly 1,300 m² figure, describing it as floor space for 10,000 servers. Because this is technical/IT space rather than gross building area, I classed it as white space. A directory listing gives 600 sq m of whitespace, but I did not use it because it is a third-party listing with a different figure. conova's 2,000 m² figure covers all its data centres, so it does not apply to this site alone.
